messages.content: What are the latest movie releases?

function.name: calculate_velocity
function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time for which the object is in motion in seconds. This is a float type value.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time information or a database of current movie releases. If you let me know a specific time period (e.g., “movies released this month” or “films coming out next year”), I can give you a general idea based on my last update, but I won’t be able to provide a definitive, up‑to‑date list.
message.reasoning: User asks "What are the latest movie releases?" They want info about recent movies. We can provide a list of recent releases. But we don't have real-time data. We could say we don't have up-to-date info. Or we can ask clarifying question: what timeframe? Or we can provide general answer: mention some recent releases from 2023/2024. But we need to be careful not to hallucinate. We can say we don't have current data. So best to respond with a polite statement that we don't have real-time data.
